INSERT INTO site_settings (settingKey, settingValue, label, description, category) VALUES
  ('lift_threshold_1_depth_in', '10', 'Lift Threshold 1 — Beam Depth (in)', 'Beam depth (inches) at or above which 1 material lift is suggested', 'pricing'),
  ('lift_threshold_2_depth_in', '14', 'Lift Threshold 2 — Beam Depth (in)', 'Beam depth (inches) at or above which a 2nd material lift is suggested', 'pricing'),
  ('lift_cost_1', '450', 'Material Lift — 1 Lift Price ($)', 'Price charged for 1 material lift', 'pricing'),
  ('lift_cost_2', '800', 'Material Lift — 2 Lifts Price ($)', 'Price charged for 2 material lifts (replaces lift_cost_1, not additive)', 'pricing')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  settingValue = VALUES(settingValue),
  label = VALUES(label),
  description = VALUES(description);
